about: C3 3rd owner: phase b alone, from the river road's checkpoint (?start=tail.river), by the proofs' good hands (src/scenes/tail/bot.js through tools/lib/c3_tail.mjs: real keys, the mouse onto his car, LMB): how long he lasts, the rounds, the hits, the fails. Ends when phase c begins (he is stopped) or after 3 minutes. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_b_good.json (NOIR_PORT=5343)

shots.b02_soft_tyre: !!G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase && (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; if (C.hisDmg && C.hisDmg.nicks >= 1) { window.__nickT = window.__nickT || N.time; return N.time - window.__nickT > 0.7; } return false; })()
shots.b02_tyre_gone: !!G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase && (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; if (C.hisDmg && C.hisDmg.tyres >= 1) { window.__goneT = window.__goneT || N.time; return N.time - window.__goneT > 0.6; } return false; })()

steps.label: the good hands stop him on the river road

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ secs: +(N.time - window.__b0).toFixed(1), shots: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.gun.shots, hits: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.gun.hits, his: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.hisDmg, fails: (window.__tailFails || []).map((f) => f.why + '@' + f.t), dmg: +G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.my.damage.toFixed(2) })
